newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: CIE begins DART rail extension to Greystones.
newsitem.headline: CIE begins DART rail extension to Greystones.

text.p: Irish transport group CIE said on Tuesday that it has started work on the 10 million Irish pound extension of the DART rail network from Bray to Greystones.
CIE chief executive Michael MacDonnell said the new extension to Greystones was the latest in a series of initiatives to improve the national network as well as the surburban rail system.
The EU Cohesion Fund is providing grant aid of 8.7 million Irish pounds for the project while CIE rail subsidiary Iarnrod Eireann is contributing 1.3 million Irish pounds.
The 4.5 mile (7.2 km) rail extension is due to be completed at the end of 1998 and will provide new substations for Bray and Greystones.
